Hi all — I reviewed the SOW. We can provision a temporary invoice-only intake for a short pilot under these conditions: 

1) FinPilot returns a signed MSA via DocuSign before provisioning (no exceptions).
2) Redwood receives a completed W-9 and AP contact (one invoice receiver + one remittance address).
3) Pilot invoice total must be under $50k and cover clear deliverables (your SOW qualifies).
4) FinPilot confirms a PO target date; if PO is not provided within 6 weeks of the pilot start, we will require prepayment or a credit card on file.
5) Redwood reserves the right to pause service for overdue invoices; standard late fees apply.

If those conditions are acceptable, Procurement will record a temporary vendor exception and route invoices to Finance for standard Net-30 processing. Please also provide a copy of your vendor onboarding evidence (company registration or VAT where applicable).

Attaching our acceptance checklist for your AP team to reference.
